scope: Push repository-scoped editable URL/destination/server-option histories, source clipboard prefilling and validated submission gates. Partial parity; full application port remains incomplete.

verification.core: All eight selected Push tests passed. New read-only submission validation preserves local config and bare-remote refs, rejecting invalid branch and incompatible save/upstream options before history saving. Existing transport, partial remotes, lease, tags, deletion, options and pre-cancel checks retained.
verification.native: Final headless native history receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. URL and option case-sensitive histories keep order; branch history selects existing case-insensitive default spelling; load leaves URL/server-option text empty. Browse inserts without saving, nil clipboard selects latest URL, injected copied git pull prefills literal URL/branch. Actual URL and named pushes and deletion operate on fixture bare refs; option with surrounding spaces/embedded punctuation is accepted and trimmed only in history. Failed transport persists histories; invalid destination does not save any; all-branch confirmation and all-branch/deletion URL/branch exclusions verified. Empty local-source change retains destination and disables tracking. Exact local HEAD/index remain. Other repository histories empty. 26-save/25-load and CR/LF folding checked. Hidden native combo preserves ordered case-distinct entries and actual selection delegate; its window closes. Queued field changes after submission do not change transported or saved snapshot values. No user pasteboard read/written.
verification.cancellation_regression: Existing Push cancellation receiver passed all four Git versions against final validation/history behavior: owned transport/helper stops, unrelated process survives, No/Yes, partial remotes and branch/tag phases retained, retry succeeds with fresh token and idle close. Both native matrices also passed before final snapshot-saving refinement.
verification.iterations: Initial core/Debug compilation failed because parser reuse called a nonexistent parse API; corrected to FetchClipboardInput.selection(isPull:true). Empty-source destination retention fixed before verification. Eight core tests and Debug passed. Final review changed history saving to submitted snapshot; rebuilt Debug and reran both four-Git native matrices with added queued-field-update check. Core not repeated for the native snapshot-only refinement. Initial failure logs retained.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified. Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and fixture operations. EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: Push parity, source inventory and NOTICE updated. Inventory pin regression and seven-column CSV validation passed. Local site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Added native Push history receiver to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push remain unverified; authentication unavailable, no retry.
verification.processes: All core/compiler/native/audit sessions terminal. No main GUI launch or displayed prompt. Hidden combo windows closed, cancellation decoys terminated/reaped by receiver cleanup. Final app/receiver audit empty. Eight empty owned PushHistory and eight empty owned PushCancellation QA UUID preference files removed across two matrices; unrelated preferences retained.
verification.limitations: Physical dropdown editing/completion/Shift-Delete/pasteboard/keyboard/resize/theme/VoiceOver, Windows locale trim/case behavior, full chooser/local-reference history/settings/preferences, project hooks/network credentials/signing and signed sandbox runtime remain pending. Full application/dialog parity, Finder activation, genuine updated screenshots/full manual, hosted publication and signed App Store distribution/license clearance remain incomplete.
